div.div:
Hard Rules (Must satisfy 100%):
• Zero room double-booking & zero lecturer clashes
• Zero student cohort overlap & strict capacity limits
• Enforce lunch breaks & campus zone boundaries
Soft Preferences (Continuous Quality Tuning):
• Minimize student fatigue & lecturer room transitions
• Avoid 7:00 AM slots & balance load across weekdays
